description: This file contains unit tests for the ConnectivityCachingSignalEnrichmentProvider class within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.mapping package. It tests loading the provider with correct and incorrect configurations, utilizes Akka ActorSystem for concurrency, and references external libraries such as AssertJ, Typesafe Config, and Akka TestKit.

methods.name: createActorSystem
methods.description: Creates an Akka ActorSystem with the provided configuration.

methods.name: shutdownActorSystem
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests.

methods.name: loadProvider
methods.description: Tests successful loading of the provider with correct configuration.

methods.name: loadProviderWithIncorrectConfig
methods.description: Tests provider loading failure with an invalid configuration.
